title: ALBIS: an ALBULA-style viewer for DECTRIS detector data
description: ALBIS is a free, open-source viewer for DECTRIS detector data, in the style of ALBULA. It opens HDF5 stacks in the filewriter1 and filewriter2 layouts, including multi-threshold data, TIFF, CBF and EDF images, and MYTHEN(2) acquisitions, from SELUN, EIGER(2), PILATUS(4), MYTHEN(2), POLLUX and JUNGFRAU detectors. It follows a running experiment through the SIMPLON monitor stream, a JUNGFRAUJOCH preview stream or externally pushed frames, and runs on the user's computer or on the machine that holds the data, viewed from a browser elsewhere. It draws resolution rings from the detector geometry, including multi-panel detectors and non-square pixels, shows pixel values when zoomed in, and provides region-of-interest statistics, spot finding, pixel mask handling, series summation, an HDF5 dataset inspector, and export to TIFF and CBF with the source metadata, to PNG figures and to animated GIF.
